create_inline_figure: create an inline figure that arranges multiple subfigures along a line with optional word wrapping
build_indented_display: build an indented figure that displays a single subfigure with vertical spacing and indentation
apply_css_style: apply a custom CSS style string to a treescope subfigure and wrap it in a TreescopeFigure
render_text_on_color: render text on a colored background using a colormap interpolated from a numeric value
convert_to_renderable_part: convert an arbitrary Python object to a renderable treescope part for display in figures
